evidence.locator: The released EP1 gamedef enters the base quest. The base quest references sidequests and additional game elements; those reference sq021, sq029 and persistent content. These are authored reference closures, not proof of current-save execution.

sq021 bad-outcome persistent content is entered only after positive Randy-loss and quest-done comparisons. Its three native NPC message branches explicitly report River killing Harris and covering his tracks; no body observation or V participation is implied. The runtime additionally requires the positive loss/completion observations and at least one revealed exact report. The alternative forgiveness message alone cannot establish this outcome.

Two sq021 abandonment branches activate Joss’s exact NPC report that she was told both bodies were found on a farm, and that she blames V for leaving. This is Joss’s private reported knowledge, not an eyewitness account, current physical-entity death detection, or permission to expose it to the party.

sq029 messages In1 -> 8-hour delay68 -> outside-family-area/content-token pause71 -> activation125 -> photograph127. The exact Joss message describes Randy gradually readjusting, expresses hope and gratitude. Positive rescue/done observations are retained. It does not establish complete medical recovery or that V read/responded.

Joss’s after-visit thanks has separate romance and non-romance branches; both are merely hospitality. The additional children’s rematch message156 follows the positive kids-won condition157. Requiring both an exact thank-you receipt and the rematch receipt qualifies the shared visit/game context while never inferring romance, optional parents disclosure or V’s reply to matchmaking.

Finale choice1450 [Release] -> cut2103 -> condition741 compares sq021_bad_farm_chosen > 0. True sets randy_kaputt=1; false sets randy_saved=1. The release is directed at Randy in the barn; River is scene actor0 with sobchak spawn identity. Later ordinary cleanup sets sq021_done=1 and after good-farm comparison sends the separate Randy-lives message. No rule treats missing bad-farm value as false. Alternate-writer audit: sq021_done is also assigned in finale node2734 after either normal wrap-up or the river_hates_v result; it does not imply affection. The cleanup's separate randy_saved writer is cited explicitly. Only the positive rescued/dead result selects Randy's fate.

rules.statement: After the failed rescue, River privately reported to V that he had killed Harris and covered his tracks. This is River’s account of what he did afterward; the message does not establish that V witnessed it or that Joss was told.

Joss sent V a private message saying she had been told that River’s and Randy’s bodies were found at a farm. She blamed V for abandoning them and said she would not forgive it. This is her received report and reaction, not something she personally witnessed.

After Randy survived the rescue, Joss told V that he was gradually easing back into things. She expressed gratitude and hope that things would be all right. This is her follow-up assessment, not proof of complete medical recovery or a message V has read or answered.

After V’s family visit and game with the children, Joss thanked V for stopping by and passed along the children’s greetings and wish for a rematch. Her hospitality does not establish a romance with River, the content of their private conversation, or V’s response to her matchmaking.
